text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy takes first place in the Takarazuka Kinen fan polls, while Sweep Tosho fails to break the top twenty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "There's just no way someone from the Triple Tiara tour would stand a chance against Triple Crown tour runners in a medium-distance race. Not to mention a senior-year one."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When it becomes clear just how widespread this sentiment is, Sweep Tosho gets even more motivated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's going to defeat Zenno Rob Roy, who has followed through on her promise to become a hero, and seize the moment to cast a spell that will change the world.
